run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the maximum rectangle area from duplicate values in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets and print the number of successful results
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which finds the two largest duplicate values and returns their product
review_f_gold: review f_gold to understand how it tracks first and second largest duplicates in an array
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a set-based approach instead of a list for duplicate detection
